items.title: Earl Watkins interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Francisco, California, August 7, 2002
items.q: And so the Commander, the fellow who was in charge of the music program, was Eddie Peabody, the banjo player.

ctx.x: Snooky was in it, yeah. Joe Thomas. Oh and Jessie Crawford the drummer, outstanding. So that was one time. And so the Commander, the fellow who was in charge of the music program, was Eddie Peabody, the banjo player. And he would, during the happy hours, he would always perform. And he was outstanding. And then of course one of the requirements for being released from training was you had to parade in front of him and do your maneuvers and everything. But he was a great guy you know. Because he was a performer.…
They took it out and did what with it?
